Amazon.Node object: two objects: ProductType (the attribute owner; required: [marketplaceIds, name, displayName], no parent, flat list) and BrowseNode (598,957 ids across 24 locales; US 31,354).
Amazon.Fields that describe leafness / kind: none on the type (flat); the browse tree has parent/child.
Amazon.Owns a schema?: the ProductType does; the browse node does not (but the type's schema constrains legal browse values).

Shopify.Owns a schema?: yes at every level (only 152 of 14,606 have none; median 6 attributes).

Google.Node object: none — “every line is id - path” in a text file (5,595 nodes, depth 7).

eBay.Fields that describe leafness / kind: leafCategoryTreeNode — true on 15,111, absent on 1,994; childCategoryTreeNodes on exactly those 1,994.
eBay.Owns a schema?: leaves do (aspects); gap pass: Food & Beverages subtree = 122 leaves.

Walmart.Node object: none — 6,967 product-type keys in one flat map; the workbook taxonomy (24 / 77 / 461) is not in the feed.

Tokopedia.Node object: Era A: Category {name, id, child []object}. Era B: Category {id, parent_id, local_name: string ("Home Supplies"), is_leaf: bool, permission_statuses: []string}.
Tokopedia.Fields that describe leafness / kind: is_leaf; permission_statuses (INVITE_ONLY needs a Qualification Center application) — a gate on who may list, not a kind.

Square.Node object: CatalogCategory {name, category_type, parent_category, is_top_level, path_to_root, root_category, online_visibility, …}.
Square.Kinds of node: three, by function (the only platform with kinds).

Salesforce B2C.Node object: one Category class with three edges per assignment: classification 0..1, primary 0..1 per catalog, assignments 0..N.
Salesforce B2C.Fields that describe leafness / kind: roles per assignment, not kinds per node.
Salesforce B2C.Owns a schema?: the classification category does (attribute groups), and inherits from ancestors.

Akeneo.Fields that describe leafness / kind: none per node; a per-tree only_leaves setting.

WooCommerce.Node object: a product_cat term — 9 properties, none an attribute set.

commercetools.Node object: Category {id, key, name, slug, parent, ancestors, orderHint, custom?, …}.

Magento.Node object: catalog_category_entity (EAV) with per-node is_anchor, custom_use_parent_settings, and its own attribute_set_id (describing the category record, not its products).
Magento.Fields that describe leafness / kind: per-node display flags (is_anchor, custom_use_parent_settings) — not “accepts products”; no kind column in the record.
Magento.Owns a schema?: no — the product's attribute set does (0 of 63 tables join a category to a product attribute).
